protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: csp_usart_open() allocates a zeroed usart_context_t whose name field is CSP_IFLIST_NAME_MAX + 1 bytes (11 bytes), then used strcpy(ctx->name, conf->device) on an unbounded caller-supplied C string. An input of 11 or more characters therefore writes the terminating NUL beyond name and can overwrite following heap-object fields.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: e143ee74d3269b2469ed389c0b475dbc836e3610 is the smallest surviving public-history commit that adds src/drivers/usart/usart_zephyr.c with both the 11-byte name field and vulnerable strcpy. Exact -S history and fix-parent blame identify only this addition and the later direct fix.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: e143ee74d3269b2469ed389c0b475dbc836e3610 has the single immediate parent a835937fe054f192f92edc91e8ede6c0bbd3d930; that parent object is present and src/drivers/usart/usart_zephyr.c is absent from its tree.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED: GitHub PR #599 reports four commits and merge_commit_sha e143ee74d3269b2469ed389c0b475dbc836e3610. Its final pre-rebase member 94a3b9cbfe559c6471986bfb5f7df029c9ff8f0e has the same complete tree and identical usart_zephyr.c blob as e143ee74, while its parent 52eae8375b45df7921e3f7088f8fd5bb2b7cb06e lacks the file. The surviving BIC is a rebased atomic member, not a squash aggregate.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: CONFIRMED WITH ADVISORY VERSION MISMATCH: e143ee74 is not an ancestor of v2.0 (a29d7cf5570f6da638d012c78676d51df97792c4), and v2.0 has no usart_zephyr.c. Thus the NVD CPE and advisory wording naming libcsp 2.0 are inaccurate; the real vulnerable interval is the develop history from e143ee74 until the fix.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: both e143ee74 and a8649782b05f67701c736dba0c51289dfa33eb7e are ancestors of v2.1 (48f7fb0b57f610bf65bab1aa2d1357c3b9722782), whose usart_zephyr.c contains the bounded strncpy call. The only tag containing either commit is v2.1.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED DIRECT FIX: a8649782b05f67701c736dba0c51289dfa33eb7e changes only strcpy(ctx->name, conf->device) to strncpy(ctx->name, conf->device, sizeof(ctx->name) - 1). Because ctx is allocated with k_calloc, the final byte remains NUL. GitHub PR #853 is a one-commit PR merged to develop with this SHA.
